elements.text: CN-TFE airframe logbook: entries from 1 January 2024 to 26 October 2026 (printed extract)

rows: 100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced right main tire. Replaced exhaust gasket at cylinder 3. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced left brake linings. Replaced all eight spark plugs. Oil and filter changed.
Found a loose pin in the KAP 140 roll servo connector. Repaired connector. Ground test of the autopilot satisfactory.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced left main tire. Serviced nose strut with hydraulic fluid and air. Oil and filter changed.

Removed engine for overhaul. Engine sent to Souss Engine Overhaul, Agadir. Reinstalled the overhauled engine, same serial number. Engine time since overhaul reset to 0.0. Ground run and leak check satisfactory. Engine logbook updated.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Removed corrosion, treated and painted battery box; neutralized battery area. Oil and filter changed.
Annual inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(a) and the scope and detail of 14 CFR Part 43 Appendix D. Replaced induction air filter. Oil and filter changed.

Static system test and altimeter test per 14 CFR 91.411 and Part 43 Appendix E. Transponder test per 14 CFR 91.413 and Part 43 Appendix F. All tests within limits. Next tests due within 24 calendar months.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Adjusted alternator belt tension per maintenance manual. Replaced exhaust gasket at cylinder 3. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced left cabin door seal. Replaced all eight spark plugs. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Serviced nose strut with hydraulic fluid and air. Replaced left main tire. Cleaned, gapped, and rotated all eight spark plugs. Oil and filter changed.
Pitot heater element open circuit. Replaced pitot tube assembly. Pitot heat check satisfactory.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced right main tire. Adjusted alternator belt tension per maintenance manual. Oil and filter changed.

100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced induction air filter. Removed corrosion, treated and painted battery box; neutralized battery area. Replaced trim tab actuator rod end bearings; free play within limits. Oil and filter changed.
Annual inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(a) and the scope and detail of 14 CFR Part 43 Appendix D. Replaced left cabin door seal. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Serviced nose strut with hydraulic fluid and air. Oil and filter changed.
Adjusted and lubricated right door latch.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Cleaned, gapped, and rotated all eight spark plugs. Replaced all eight spark plugs. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced left brake linings. Replaced exhaust gasket at cylinder 3. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced trim tab actuator rod end bearings; free play within limits. Oil and filter changed.
100-hour inspection per 14 CFR 91.409(b). Replaced left cabin door seal. Oil and filter changed.
